pairs.subject: browser-credential-boundary
pairs.evidence: src-tauri/src/commands/browser/sites.rs:80 The whitelist binds a site to a vault credential by id only, through a #[requires(privileged)] command. The site shape the webview receives carries credentialId and no secret column, so the login secret stays in Rust.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/bindings/BrowserSite.ts:26 The site shape has a reference column and no column for the secret value; SiteChips.tsx:104 renders only bound or none.
src-tauri/src/commands/browser/sites.rs:80 The UI sends origin and credential_id. The secret is resolved server-side when browser_login runs. The command is gated privileged.

src/features/browser/whitelist/useWhitelistActions.ts:66 Confirming a scan sends only the origin, so the scan result stays server-side and the client never carries it back (the keep-it-server-side variant).
src/features/browser/whitelist/AddSiteModal.tsx:75 The origin is operator-typed configuration, validated to scheme://host[:port]. It is not an address that arrives inside a dependency's response.
src/features/browser/whitelist/useWhitelistActions.ts:55 No upstream broker is involved: failures are local command refusals from a closed BrowserRefusalCode vocabulary, shown to the local operator.

pairs.subject: browser-credential-boundary
pairs.evidence: src/features/vault/sub_databases/tabs/ChatTab.tsx:295 The database tabs send only a credential id and the SQL. Rust attaches the connection secret, fetches through the SSRF-safe client, scrubs credential fields from errors and re-classifies mutations itself, so the webview never holds a database credential.

techniques.evidence: src/features/vault/sub_databases/tabs/ChatTab.tsx:295 Only credentialId and the SQL cross IPC; the credential is attached in the Rust engine.
src-tauri/engine/src/db_query.rs:138 Hosts that come from credential data are fetched through the SSRF-safe resolver client, which judges the resolved address.
src-tauri/engine/src/db_query.rs:148 The database belongs to the operator, so error detail is legitimate for them; credential field values are scrubbed before the error returns.
src/features/vault/sub_databases/tabs/ChatTab.tsx:225 Telemetry carries an enumerated bucket and never the SQL text. Console history is kept in memory only (ConsoleTab.tsx:51).

src-tauri/engine/src/db_query.rs:703 The SQL and the allowMutation flag are the operator's own input. The server re-derives the mutation class instead of trusting a carried result, so there is nothing to seal.
